SELECT H.id , H.dutyAddr , H.dutyAddr1Depth , H.dutyAddr2Depth , H.dutyAddr3Depth , H.dutyEtc , H.dutyName , H.dutyTel1 , H.wgs84Lat , H.wgs84Lon
, H.dutyTime1c AS 1c , H.dutyTime1s AS 1s
, H.dutyTime2c AS 2c , H.dutyTime2s AS 2s
, H.dutyTime3c AS 3c , H.dutyTime3s AS 3s
, H.dutyTime4c AS 4c , H.dutyTime4s AS 4s
, H.dutyTime5c AS 5c , H.dutyTime5s AS 5s
, H.dutyTime6c AS 6c , H.dutyTime6s AS 6s
, H.dutyTime7c AS 7c , H.dutyTime7s AS 7s
, ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lon}, #{lat}), POINT(H.wgs84Lon, H.wgs84Lat)) AS distance FROM hsptl H
WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lon}, #{lat}), POINT(H.wgs84Lon, H.wgs84Lat)) <= #{limit} ORDER BY distance LIMIT #{startIndexNo} , #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hsptl WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(POINT(#{lon}, #{lat}), POINT(wgs84Lon, wgs84Lat)) <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT H.id , H.dutyAddr , H.dutyAddr1Depth , H.dutyAddr2Depth , H.dutyAddr3Depth , H.dutyEtc , H.dutyName , H.dutyTel1 , H.wgs84Lat , H.wgs84Lon
, H.dutyTime1c AS 1c , H.dutyTime1s AS 1s
, H.dutyTime2c AS 2c , H.dutyTime2s AS 2s
, H.dutyTime3c AS 3c , H.dutyTime3s AS 3s
, H.dutyTime4c AS 4c , H.dutyTime4s AS 4s
, H.dutyTime5c AS 5c , H.dutyTime5s AS 5s
, H.dutyTime6c AS 6c , H.dutyTime6s AS 6s
, H.dutyTime7c AS 7c , H.dutyTime7s AS 7s
FROM hsptl H WHERE 1=1
AND H.dutyName LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchStr},'%')
ORDER BY H.dutyName DESC )List LIMIT #{startIndexNo} , #{pageSize}
